records.key: A model trained on microscopy rather than photographs. OpenPhenom and ChAda-ViT take any number of stains. SubCell's two-plane model takes DNA then protein; its four-plane model needs explicit microtubules, ER, DNA and protein mapping. Other weights download once. Cell-DINO requires a local official checkpoint, declared SHA-256 and explicit model-plane mapping. Default None (use the backbone).
records.source: A model trained on microscopy rather than photographs. OpenPhenom and ChAda-ViT take any number of stains. SubCell's two-plane model takes DNA then protein; its four-plane model needs explicit microtubules, ER, DNA and protein mapping. Other weights download once. Cell-DINO requires a local official checkpoint, declared SHA-256 and explicit model-plane mapping. Default None (use the backbone).
records.translation: Un modelo entrenado con imágenes de microscopía en lugar de fotografías. OpenPhenom y ChAda-ViT aceptan cualquier número de tinciones. El modelo de dos planos de SubCell utiliza DNA y después proteína; su modelo de cuatro planos requiere asignar explícitamente microtúbulos, ER, DNA y proteína. Los demás pesos se descargan una vez. Cell-DINO requiere un punto de control oficial local, un SHA-256 declarado y una asignación explícita de los planos del modelo. Predeterminado None (usar la red base).
